title: pyrrosia winkleri
intro: Pyrrosia winkleri, commonly known as Winkler's tree fern or Winkler's polypody, is a species of plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its high antioxidant content. The bioactive constituents of Pyrrosia winkleri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various conditions, including fever, cough, and sore throats.
